column3: Use the attached character image as the main character (H). Keep his face, bald head with the white letter "H" on the forehead, skin tone, body and outfit (black shorts, olive tactical belt with pouches, black wrist wraps, olive sneakers) 100% identical. Same semi-realistic comic illustration style with bold clean outlines and smooth shading, highly detailed muscles. The same character appears twice. BRAND TEMPLATE (follow exactly): the image is split vertically into two equal halves with a clean straight edge. LEFT HALF: flat dark muted red background (#7A1A1A). IMPORTANT BODY CHANGE ON THIS SIDE ONLY: H's arms are extremely thin, like skinny noodles or sticks (no visible biceps at all, very thin forearms), while his chest and legs stay normal; he flexes both noodle arms proudly with a funny confident face. The contrast with the huge arms on the right must be obvious. Big white heavy italic word at the top of this half: 'LEVEL 1'. RIGHT HALF: flat fresh teal background (#0F8B85). H flexing both huge bodybuilder arms, massive biceps and triceps, confident grin. Big white heavy italic word at the top of this half: 'LEVEL 5'. Both words in the same extra-bold condensed italic sans-serif, white with a thin dark outline and a soft drop shadow, the same size, NO box behind them. Both figures the same size, standing on the same invisible floor line, full body, centred in their half. Vertical 9:16, 1080x1920, YouTube Shorts thumbnail. Keep both figures and both words inside the central 70% of the height. Avoid: any other text, label boxes, watermarks, extra characters, spelling mistakes, extra limbs or fingers, changing the character design, photo realism, clutter.
